name: A Lack of Virtue

narrative.details:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
narrative.objectives: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Bart unwraps the gift.>Why that no good, son of a--Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
narrative.requestItemsText: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
